description: Client-side script for managing the 'Production Plan' form in ERPNext, including setup, refresh, item queries, progress display, and related actions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup of the Production Plan form, including button and query configurations.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, updates buttons, progress, and field options based on document status.

methods.name: close_open_production_plan
methods.description: Sets the production plan status to closed or open via server call.

methods.name: make_work_order
methods.description: Creates a new work order related to the production plan.

methods.name: make_material_request
methods.description: Initiates creation of a material request with user confirmation.

methods.name: create_material_request
methods.description: Calls server method to create a material request, optionally submitting it.

methods.name: get_sales_orders
methods.description: Fetches open sales orders related to the production plan.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves items for the production plan.

methods.name: combine_items
methods.description: Combines and fetches items, including sub-assembly items if present.

methods.name: get_sub_assembly_items
methods.description: Fetches sub-assembly items for the production plan.

methods.name: get_items_for_mr
methods.description: Prepares and fetches items for material requests, with optional warehouse selection dialog.

methods.name: download_materials_required
methods.description: Downloads raw materials required for planning based on selected warehouses.

methods.name: show_progress
methods.description: Displays production progress dashboard with item quantities.
